{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'sex' column
print('Unique values in sex:', trial_df['sex'].unique())

# Check the distribution of sex
print('\nSex distribution:')
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of responded by sex
print('\nResponded by sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['responded']))

# Compute response rates by sex
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rates by sex:')
print(response_rates)"}
